Title: RM650 modular cable compabilty - Build Hardware Troubleshooting - Corsair Community
URL: https://forum.corsair.com/forums/topic/193201-rm650-modular-cable-compabilty/
Published: 2025-02-13T11:48:43.000Z
Author: N/A
Highlights:
# RM650 modular cable compabilty

...

Hi Experts. Mid 2021 i build a computer with a RM650 PSU, it works perfectly. I'm now looking at upgrading my PSU to a 750W or 850W model, and I'm wondering if my old cables will be reusable (A quick change). 

 I found this page, but i'm not 100% sure on how to read it. https://www.corsair.com/us/en/s/psu-cable-compatibility

...

### Cor.Fan 

 If your PSU is also a 2021 model then it uses Type 4 cables. Those cables are still in use in many models. 

 Do you have any SKU or something that confirms it's a 2021 version? 

> 22 hours ago, Cor.Fan said: 
> 
> If your PSU is also a 2021 model then it uses Type 4 cables. Those cables are still in use in many models. 
> 
> Do you have any SKU or something that confirms it's a 2021 version? 

 Hi Cor.Fan. According to my invoice, it is " CP-9020194-EU" It seems to be type 4: 

 https://www.corsair.com/eu/en/p/psu/cp-9020194-eu/rm-series-rm650-650-watt-80-plus-gold-certified-fully-modular-psu-eu-cp-9020194-eu So, what new PSU's use Type 4 cables, how to spot that? Regards 

 Jens. 

 Most new PSU models use Type 4 cables, except for SHIFT series which use Type 5. 

 You can enter Corsair website and check the PSU that interests you; it clearly states the cable type for the unit. 

> 19 hours ago, Cor.Fan said: 
> 
> Most new PSU models use Type 4 cables, except for SHIFT series which use Type 5. 
> 
> You can enter Corsair website and check the PSU that interests you; it clearly states the cable type for the unit. 

 Awesome! Thank you. 🙂 

 /Jens.
